ask.title: Ask your files
ask.subtitle: Questions are answered only from your own documents, with a numbered source for every claim.
ask.placeholder: What did the budget review cover?
ask.invalid: Cites sources that do not exist: {{list}}.
ask.modelHelp: Connect any local OpenAI-compatible server (Ollama, llama.cpp, LM Studio). Plain HTTP on this machine only, unless you allow otherwise below. The API key, if any, is read from MNEMO_LLM_API_KEY.
ask.allowRemote: Allow a server on another machine. Your questions and document passages will leave this device.

activity.title: Activity
activity.subtitle: Where your time went. Stored only on this machine.
activity.windowsHint: Records which app and window title is in front. Idle time is not counted. Password managers and private windows are skipped.
activity.browserHint: Reads Chrome, Edge, Brave and Firefox history copies every 30 minutes. Sensitive sites are skipped.
activity.offBody: Turn on a source above to see your day here. It is off until you choose.
activity.empty: Nothing recorded in this period yet.

security.encryptHint: Encrypts the text of your documents in the search index and your activity titles and URLs. The key is bound to your Windows account (DPAPI) and never leaves this computer.
security.restart: Restart Mnemo to apply. Changing this rebuilds the search index; the unencrypted copy is deleted.
security.limits: Not covered: file names and paths in the metadata database, and image thumbnails. Use BitLocker for full-disk protection.
